title: Recurring effort in a fictional debt repayment case
method: Synthetic model: four changes ×three extra hours=12monthly. After consolidation, upkeep=2 hours. Net release=10 hours;30hour implementation/10=3 months simple payback. Excludes risk and alternative-work value.
alt: A hypothetical duplicated rule costs 12 hours monthly; shared-rule upkeep costs two.
